The '''Arms Emporium''' was a famous weaponry-dealing store owned by [[Masse Goskey/Legends|Masse Goskey]]. It was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Paradise Road/Legends|Paradise Road]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
